en: This collection includes 4 drawings from the Haft Owrang (Seven Thrones) manuscript of the Persian poet Nezami Ganjavi, which was commissioned by the Timurid prince Ibrahim Sultan in the early 15th century. The Haft Owrang is a collection of seven narrative poems that are considered masterpieces of Persian literature. The drawings in this collection depict scenes from these poems and are important examples of Persian miniature painting.

value.en: Folio from the Silsilat al-dhahab (Chain of gold) from the Haft awrang (Seven thrones) by Jami; text: Persian in black nasta'liq script; recto: text, illuminated headings in blue and red, gold column dividers, triangular verse illuminations; four columns, twenty-one lines of text; verso: The simple peasant entreats the salesman not to sell his wonderful donkey; one of a group of 304 folios. Border: The recto is set in multicolored rulings stenciled in pink, outlined in gold; the verso is set in multicolored rulings on cream-colored paper with gold floral motifs.
